lines.text: Cloudflare says AI hacking tools are spreading fast, and requests from them are up thirty times.
ARTEX let many AI agents test a target at once. Its creator took it down, but copies spread.
lines.title: The tool

lines.text: Cloudflare tracks more than fifty tool families, with thousands of addresses running them.
lines.title: What Cloudflare sees

lines.text: In one case, attackers used a stolen key that never expired, then hopped between systems and tried to copy databases.
lines.title: One incident

lines.text: Machines work at machine speed, so old keys and forgotten doors get found quickly.
lines.title: Old vs new

lines.text: Cloudflare's advice uses a house metaphor: strong gates, a guard, bot checks, no back doors, and a neighborhood watch.
lines.title: Modern Security Model

lines.text: Use short-lived keys, check who gets in, and keep systems separate.
